description: This file defines the PdfTrailer class, representing a PDF trailer dictionary within the PDFsharp library. It manages trailer-specific properties such as document ID, root catalog, size, and security, and provides methods for trailer handling and security management.

classes.name: PdfTrailer
classes.description: Represents a PDF trailer dictionary, managing trailer-specific key properties and references within a PDF document.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Gets or sets the total number of entries in the PDF's cross-reference table.

methods.name: Root
methods.description: Returns the root catalog dictionary of the PDF.

methods.name: GetDocumentID
methods.description: Retrieves one of the document's unique identifiers based on the provided index.

methods.name: SetDocumentID
methods.description: Sets one of the document's unique identifiers at a specified index.

methods.name: CreateNewDocumentIDs
methods.description: Generates and sets new, identical document identifiers.

methods.name: PreviousTrailer
methods.description: Gets or sets the previous trailer, useful for incremental updates.

methods.name: SecurityHandler
methods.description: Gets or creates the standard security handler for the PDF.

methods.name: EffectiveSecurityHandler
methods.description: Gets the standard security handler if encryption is active.

methods.name: WriteObject
methods.description: Writes the trailer object to the PDF stream.

methods.name: Finish
methods.description: Finalizes references within the trailer, resolving indirect references to their actual objects.
